query.description: Text to search for in model names and IDs.

provider.description: Provider ID or name to filter by. Try your own provider first.

all.description: Include older versions of each model family. By default only the newest version is listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return. Defaults to 20.

offset.description: Number of models to skip, for paging through results.

released.description: Release date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds, or 0 when unknown.

cost.description: Pricing in USD per million tokens.

providers.description: Matching models grouped by provider. Your own provider comes first.

total.description: Number of matching models across all pages.

next.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last page.
